definitions: A cylinder or set of cylinders used for flattening, shaping, or moving something.
A long, curling wave of the sea that breaks on the shore.
A small wheel or cylinder on which something can roll or be rolled.
A bird of the family Coraciidae, typically brightly coloured, found in warm regions of the Old World.
examples: She used a roller to paint the wall.
The surfers waited for a roller.
The conveyor belt had a roller missing.
A roller flew past the window.
